title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Laboratory carbon-aerogel removal performance does not by itself establish reliable operation in real environmental media.
explanation: The review cites inconsistent properties across starting materials and operating conditions, difficulty producing large homogeneous aerogels, and competitive adsorption or pore blocking by constituents of real waters.
scope: Scale-up and pilot deployment of carbon-aerogel environmental treatments.
conditions: Complex media, including natural organic matter and harsh water chemistry, require testing.
caveats: Recyclability, mechanical integrity, regeneration cost, and standardized material properties also affect practical viability.
